row.body: The gate key is tied to a resident roster that marks the community empty before the final visitor signed out.
row.title: Gated community access

sidecar.gloss: The community is logged empty while a visitor remains checked in.
sidecar.rival_reading: A planned maintenance closure could produce the same gap; the roster does not explain who remained.

row.body: the red pen and camera are wrapped in a child's raincoat. one stayed dry while the other was left in road mud.
row.title: missing count beside the red pen

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
